title: Tax-Exempt Purchasing on Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms): Certificate Validity and Refund Window
content:
Tax-exempt purchasing is supported on every tier of Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms) once a valid certificate is on file. A certificate stays valid on file for the tier's number of months before renewal is required, and covers purchases for the state of the store or the shipping destination of the order.

| Terms tier | Tax-exempt purchasing supported | Months a certificate stays valid before renewal | Window for refunding tax charged on an invoice (calendar days after the invoice date) | States a certificate covers |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | Yes | 36 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | Yes | 36 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | Yes | 36 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | Yes | 36 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | Yes | 36 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | Yes | 60 | 90 | Store state or ship-to state of the order |

- **Certificate validity.** 36 months on every tier except Net 30 Public Sector, where it is 60 months.
- **Refund window.** The number of calendar days after an invoice date within which sales tax charged on it is refunded once a valid certificate covering that date is filed: 90 days on every tier.
- **States covered.** A certificate covers purchases where its state is the state of the store or the shipping destination of the order.
